title: Classic Northern Circuit
subtitle: Safari
description: See some of Tanzania's best parks with a private guide, amazing wildlife, and a pace that feels easy.
overview: This is a strong first safari for travelers who want famous parks, great wildlife, and a route that feels simple to follow. It gives you a good mix of variety and comfort without trying to do too much at once.
goodFor: Travelers who want a balanced pace
Guests who want strong wildlife viewing
sampleFeatures: Lodge or camp options by budget
Help before and during the trip
planningNotes: Easy to extend with Zanzibar after the safari
Works well for travelers with one week in Tanzania
Can be shaped for luxury or mid-range travel
season: Good most of the year, with strong wildlife viewing in dry months
bestTripLength: 6 to 8 days works best for this route, with extra time if you want Zanzibar after the safari.
bestTime: Dry-season months are strong for classic wildlife viewing, but the route can still work well in other good travel windows.
transportStyle: Private road safari with a guide and vehicle from Arusha through the parks.
transferPlan: Usually starts and ends around Arusha, with airport or town support stays before and after the parks if needed.
supportLevel: Guided throughout, with help before arrival, during the safari, and for the next part of the trip after the parks.
accommodationLogic: Often uses Arusha as the start point, then safari lodges or tented camps placed to keep the park flow smooth and the driving days realistic.
inclusions: Park routing shaped around your dates
Stay options matched to your budget level
exclusions: Extra nights or add-ons outside the agreed route

sampleDays.title: Arrive in Arusha
sampleDays.description: Arrive, rest, and get ready for the safari. This first night gives you time to settle in before the parks begin.

sampleDays.title: Drive to Tarangire
sampleDays.description: Start with elephants, baobabs, and classic game viewing in Tarangire, then continue to your lodge for the night.

sampleDays.title: Ngorongoro area
sampleDays.description: Travel toward the highlands and prepare for a full day in one of Tanzania's most famous wildlife areas.

sampleDays.title: Ngorongoro to Serengeti
sampleDays.description: Enjoy wildlife viewing and continue on toward the Serengeti for the next part of the journey.

sampleDays.title: Full day in Serengeti
sampleDays.description: Spend the day on game drives across the plains, looking for big cats and the wildlife the park is known for.

sampleDays.title: Final safari day
sampleDays.description: Enjoy one more strong safari day, with time to slow down and take in the best moments of the trip.

sampleDays.title: Return and depart
sampleDays.description: Travel back toward Arusha for your onward flight or the next part of your Tanzania journey.

title: Machame Kilimanjaro Ascent
subtitle: Climb
description: Climb Kilimanjaro with a strong team, a clear route, and good time to adjust to the altitude.
overview: This trip is built for travelers who want the challenge of Kilimanjaro with a route that gives good scenery, a clear climb rhythm, and steady support from the crew. It is active, rewarding, and best for guests who are ready for a real adventure.
goodFor: Guests who want a famous African climb
planningNotes: Can be followed by safari or Zanzibar recovery time
Best for guests prepared for long walking days
Works well for travelers who want a strong challenge
season: Best in drier months with clearer mountain conditions
bestTripLength: 6 to 8 days on the mountain, plus extra nights in Moshi before or after the climb.
bestTime: Best in drier months when mountain conditions are usually clearer and the climb flow feels more stable.
transportStyle: Road transfers between Moshi, the gate, and the return point, with the climb itself run on foot with mountain crew support.
transferPlan: Usually includes Moshi or Arusha support nights before the climb, plus return transfers after descent.
supportLevel: Full mountain crew support with climb guidance, camp setup, meals on the route, and help with pre-climb logistics.
accommodationLogic: Support stays are usually in Moshi before and after the climb, with mountain camps used during the ascent itself.
inclusions: Mountain support crew and climb guidance
Daily rhythm shaped around altitude adjustment
exclusions: Personal climbing gear or gear rental

sampleDays.title: Moshi briefing
sampleDays.description: Arrive, meet the team, and prepare your gear before the climb begins.

sampleDays.title: Machame Gate to first camp
sampleDays.description: Start the climb through forest paths and settle into the mountain rhythm with your crew.

sampleDays.title: Climb higher through changing views
sampleDays.description: Gain altitude, enjoy wider views, and continue building strength for the summit push.

sampleDays.title: Barranco and acclimatization
sampleDays.description: Move through one of the best-known sections of the route and continue adjusting to the mountain.

sampleDays.title: Final camp before summit
sampleDays.description: Take a shorter day, rest, and get ready for the late-night summit attempt.

sampleDays.title: Summit and descend
sampleDays.description: Push for the summit, celebrate the achievement, and begin the descent with the support of the team.

title: Zanzibar Recovery Escape
subtitle: Beach stay
description: Slow down by the sea, enjoy warm beaches, and add simple island fun if you want.
accent: Great after safari or for a honeymoon
overview: This is a soft, easy trip for travelers who want to rest, reset, and enjoy the coast. It works especially well after safari or Kilimanjaro, and it can be kept very simple or made more special for a honeymoon feel.
goodFor: Travelers who want beach time without pressure
Guests who want a short coastal finish
sampleFeatures: Flexible pace with room to rest
planningNotes: Very easy to add after safari or Kilimanjaro
Can be shaped for quiet beach time or light activity
season: Good most of the year, depending on rain and beach conditions
stayStyle: Boutique beach resort or relaxed coastal stay
bestTripLength: 4 to 6 days works well on its own or after safari or Kilimanjaro.
bestTime: Works in many travel windows, with beach conditions and rainfall helping shape which coast feels best.
transportStyle: Airport or ferry transfers with light island movement between Stone Town and your beach stay if you combine both.
transferPlan: Usually starts with an arrival transfer, then beach or town connections, and ends with airport support on departure day.
supportLevel: Planning help for transfers, stay choice, and optional light activities, while keeping the trip easy and flexible.
accommodationLogic: Can be built around one main beach stay or split between Stone Town and the coast depending on your pace.
inclusions: Flexible island pace with space to rest
exclusions: International flights or island tickets outside the agreed plan
Optional excursions not included in the route

sampleDays.title: Arrive in Zanzibar
sampleDays.description: Arrive on the island, transfer to your stay, and settle into a slower pace.

sampleDays.title: Beach day
sampleDays.description: Take a full day to swim, rest, and enjoy the beach with no pressure to rush anywhere.

sampleDays.title: Optional island activity
sampleDays.description: Add something light like Stone Town, a spice visit, or a short boat trip if you want more variety.

sampleDays.title: More time to relax
sampleDays.description: Enjoy another slow day by the sea with time for food, sun, and quiet moments.

sampleDays.title: Departure
sampleDays.description: Transfer to the airport or continue to your onward travel feeling rested and refreshed.
